messages:
auditor-bot: Quick request from ISO auditor - need evidence bundle for an emergency KMS rotation that was performed as part of a suspected key-exposure event. Specifically: CloudTrail + KMS events around the rotation window, proof of the RBAC rollback that limited access during the event, scheduled role-review logs for the affected privileged roles (last 180d), HSM attestation for the CMKs, and a signed manifest (SHA256 + HMAC using auditor-provided nonce). Delivery requested by 2026-04-20 EOD. Who can own what?

nina: assigning owners: i'll take RBAC rollback logs + role-review schedule exports and assemble the custody statement. @oz pls take CloudTrail/KMS raw exports. @pat pls collect HSM attestation + key import/wrap logs. legal - can you confirm wording for custody statement?

oz: can do. quick q: auditors want raw CloudTrail JSON for the event window and a CSV timeline? prefer to include both.

auditor-bot: both please (CSV timeline for quick read, raw JSON for forensic). Include event IDs so we can validate correlations.

pat: noted - HSM vendor attestation (FIPS paper + vendor signature) available. will include CloudHSM import logs, key-wrap entries, and KMS GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext events. i'll stage to s3://evidence/emergency-kms/hsm/ and include checksums.

nina: for RBAC rollback, we need: (1) the change-set showing role policy detachments, (2) any temporary deny policies applied, and (3) the approval/exec log that authorized the rollback. i'll pull Splunk + GitHub approval tickets.

engsec-bot: Recommended Splunk filters for RBAC change-set (90d window):
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=DetachRolePolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
| table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters, awsRegion, eventID
| where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d")
```

oz: i'll also run a CloudTrail export for KMS events around 2026-02-27..2026-03-02. CloudTrail CLI snippet i'll use:
```
aws cloudtrail start-export-task --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2026-02-27T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-02T23:59:59Z --destination-s3-bucket-name evidence --destination-s3-prefix emergency-kms/raw
```

pat: rotation date confirmed 2026-02-28 14:37:12 UTC. i'll include key state snapshots before/after rotation and the KMS key policy revision history. one note: a few principals are redacted in logs - i'll produce a redaction mapping (full mapping in HSM-protected bundle for auditors under NDA).

nina: legal - wording for custody statement: we need a short signed paragraph confirming chain-of-custody, who handled the evidence, and HMAC details. can you supply template?

legal: i can draft. draft language: "Redwood Inference confirms custody of the enclosed digital artifacts from collection through delivery. Attached manifest is signed with internal HMAC key id=hk-2025-09 and includes auditor nonce when provided." will that work?

nina: good. engsec-bot - auditor wants HMAC with auditor nonce. can we generate an HMAC-signed manifest and include verification steps?

engsec-bot: yes. manifest process: 1) gather s3 object keys, 2) compute SHA256 per object, 3) produce manifest JSON (file, sha256, size, s3_key), 4) compute HMAC-SHA256(manifest_json, auditor_nonce) with internal key, 5) sign custody statement and attach. We'll provide verification script: `verify_manifest.py --manifest manifest.json --hmac <value> --auditor-nonce <nonce>`.

ops-bot: presign reminder: presigned URLs expire in 7 days. Use `s3-presign --expires 604800`. tag S3 objects with `checksum-sha256` and `manifest-id`.

oz: ETA for raw exports + CSV timeline: 2026-04-16 EOD. i'll include eventIDs and upload to s3://evidence/emergency-kms/rbac/ and s3://evidence/emergency-kms/raw/. i'll tag with `manifest-id=emg-20260416`.

pat: HSM attestation + key-wrap logs ETA: 2026-04-15 EOD. i'll include vendor attestation PDF and CloudHSM import logs. also adding `checksum-sha256` tags.

nina: RBAC rollback and role-review logs ETA: 2026-04-15 AM. i'll pull scheduled role-review reports (last 180d) and approval ticket exports. note: some approval comments include personal emails - we'll redact in public CSV and place mapping in HSM-protected artifact.

legal: i'll sign custody statement after manifest is assembled. please include the auditor nonce at upload time.

auditor-bot: one more ask: proof of detection -> include Opsgenie alerting that triggered the rotation (timestamps, responders, escalation path).

oz: will export Opsgenie incident IR-2026-062 and put to s3://evidence/emergency-kms/incidents/IR-2026-062/.

nina: final deliverables checklist: - CloudTrail/KMS raw + CSV timeline -> oz - RBAC rollback + role-review exports -> nina - HSM vendor attestation + key-wrap logs -> pat - Opsgenie alert history -> oz - Signed manifest (SHA256 per file + HMAC w/auditor nonce) + custody statement -> nina/legal - Pre-review by eng-security -> nina 2026-04-18 AM.

nina: escalate to #eng-security with :rotating_light: if anyone misses ETA. oz/pat please post presigned links here when objects are uploaded so legal can sign and we can deliver.

oz: will do. posting once done.

pat: noted. adding redaction map and HSM-protected mapping.

auditor-bot: Acknowledged. Auditor expects delivery by 2026-04-20 EOD and will verify SHA256 checksums + HMAC validation on receipt. Thanks."
